title: Latency fingerprint registry + per-route/model/region p95-p99 explorer
creator: Marta Reyes
description:
Background:
We currently emit high-cardinality telemetry for traces and some percentile rollups, but product teams struggle to answer the question: 'Which exact combination of route + model + region contributed to last night's p95 regressions?' This ticket creates a searchable latency fingerprint registry and a per-route/model/region explorer that ties tokens/sec, p95, p99 and contextual signals (sequence-length distribution, KV cache hit rate, batch size, backend GPU utilization).

Goals:
- Define a compact latency fingerprint (route, model, region, profile-hash, seq_len_bucket, batch_bucket, kv_hit_rate_bucket) and start emitting that as a tag on percentile telemetry streams.
- Build a Grafana explorer with three entry points: global heatmap, route-level drilldown, and regression diff view (compare baseline vs current).
- Produce nightly regression detection that alerts when p95 or p99 increases by config thresholds for a sustained window and correlates with tokens/sec or batch changes.
- Provide a small playback harness to reproduce load with the same profile for forensics.

Telemetry & schema decisions (proposal):
- Emit metrics: latency_p50/p95/p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, seq_len_mean, kv_hit_rate, batch_size, backend_gpu_util_pct.
- Fingerprint key = sha1(route||'|'||model||'|'||region||'|'||seq_bucket||'|'||batch_bucket||'|'||kv_bucket) stored as hex string.
- Retention: full-fidelity fingerprints for 90 days; aggregated rollups for 365 days (trade-off: storage vs investigation window).

Dashboard UX outline:
- Global heatmap: x-axis = model family, y-axis = route group, cell color = delta(p95) last 24h vs baseline. Click opens route/model/region panel.
- Route panel: time-series for p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, kv_hit_rate; below a card with 'likely causes' derived from correlation scoring.
- Regression diff: side-by-side distributions (baseline vs current), waterfall of contributing fingerprint slices ordered by delta p95 and request volume.

Regression detection algorithm (initial):
- Nightly batch: for each fingerprint, compute bootstrap CI on p95/p99 plus nonparametric two-sample test (Mann-Whitney/KS) between baseline window (last 7 days) and current window (last 24h).
- Raise candidate if p95 increases > 20% and p95 p-value < 0.01 and request volume > 1000.
- Correlate candidates against tokens/sec and backend util; attach confidence score.

Implementation plan / milestones:
1) Instrumentation (2 sprints): schema rollout and SDK emit changes. Backfill where possible for last 7 days. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/652 (WIP).
2) Storage & index (1 sprint): add fingerprint index to bigquery/metrics store; partition by date. Table design in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Latency+Fingerprint+Registry.
3) Explorer & dashboards (1 sprint): prototype Grafana panels and share with SRE/Platform for feedback. Grafana draft: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency-explorer.
4) Nightly regression job & alerts (1 sprint): CI job that produces Slack/Console alerts and creates a Linear ticket when confidence high.
5) Playback harness (1 sprint optional): small loadsmith profile writer to re-run fingerprints locally for forensics. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/loadsmith-profiles/pull/14

Acceptance criteria:
- Fingerprint tag is present on emitted percentile metrics for 95% of traffic in staging and 80% in prod within two weeks of rollout.
- Grafana explorer allows filtering by route, model, region, and seq_len_bucket and shows p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec time-series.
- Nightly job surfaces at least one real regression during rollout test (synthetic injection) and creates a Linear ticket with diagnostic bundle.
- Regression alert includes top-3 contributing fingerprints and links to playback profile.

Trade-offs & open questions:
- Storage retention vs cost: Proposed 90/365 split is conservative; ops may want shorter retention.
- Fingerprint cardinality: bucketing strategy must balance explanatory power and cardinality blow-up. Initial buckets chosen to cap unique keys to ~5-10k per day.
- Test signal validity: small routes may throw false positives; we require a minimum volume threshold.

Dependencies:
- ENG-30777 (batching throughput rhythm and guardrails) -- we rely on tokens/sec instrumentation.
- ENG-27542 (synthetic kernelized harness) -- playback profiles for forensics.

Artifacts & links:
- Draft design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Latency+Fingerprint+Registry
- Telemetry PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/652
- Playback harness PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/loadsmith-profiles/pull/14
- Grafana workspace: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency-explorer

Review notes so far:
- SRE (Anika Rocha) requested adding backend_cpu and gpu_temp metrics to provide additional correlation signals.
- PM (Jonah Patel) suggested exposing an API endpoint so product teams can fetch fingerprint-level stats programmatically; added to backlog.
- Design reviewed panel mockups; feedback: add quick links to associated PRs and incident tickets when available.

Next steps (short term):
- Finish telemetry PR and run in staging (Marta).
- Provision BigQuery table and ingestion pipeline (Liam).
- Build Grafana skeleton and schedule review with SRE and PM (this ticket).
